newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Lyndhurst, N.J.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Township of Lyndhurst
(In the County of Bergen)
New Jersey
Consisting of
$7,198,000 General Improvement Bonds of 1996
$3,582,000 Fiscal Year Adjustment Bonds
$706,000 Water Capital Bonds of 1996
(Book-Entry-Only)(Callable)
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Chief Financial
Officer of the Township of Lyndhurst, in the County of
Bergen, New Jersey (the Township) at the Municipal
Building, 367 Valley Brook Avenue, Lyndhurst, New Jersey
07071 on September 24, 1996 until 11:00 a.m, prevailing
local time, subject to the provisions of the Official Notice
of Sale dated September 11, 1996 (the Notice of Sale'').
Sale Date: Tuesday, September 24, 1996
Time: 11:00 a.m.
Bonds Dated:October 1, 1996
Maturities:
General Improvement Bonds of 1996
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
Fiscal Year Adjustment Bonds
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
Water Capital Bonds of 1996
Principal Principal Principal
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount
Denominations: $5,000 each or any integral multiple
thereof, except that such minimum amount of the last
maturing Bonds in excess of the largest principal amount
thereof equaling a multiple of $5,000 will be in the
denomination of $1,000 or any integral multiple thereof, as
may be necessary to comply with the proposal of the
successful bidder of the Bonds to accept less than the full
amount of the Bonds offered for public sale in accordance
with the Notice of Sale.
Interest Rate: The Bonds will bear interest at the
specified by the successful bidder determined in accordance
with the Notice of Sale.
Redemption: The Bonds are subject to redemption prior to
their stated Maturities in accordance with the Notice of
Sale.
Bond Counsel:Carella, Byrne, Bain, Gilfillan, Cecchi,
Stewart &Olstein, Roseland, New Jersey.
The Bonds shall be issued in registered form by means of
a book-entry system with no physical distribution of bond
certificates made to the public. One bond certificate for
each maturity will be issued to The Depository Trust
Company, New York, New York (DTC'') and immobilized in its
custody. The book-entry system will evidence ownership of
the Bonds in the principal amount of $1,000 or any multiple
thereof, with transfers of ownership effected on the records
of DTC and its participants pursuant to rules and procedures
established by DTC and its participants. The Bonds are
subject to redemption prior to maturity at the option of the
Township in accordance with the terms set forth in the
Notice of Sale to be made available to interested persons
(the Notice of Sale). This Summar Sale is
intended only as a brief summary of the Notice of Sale which
Notice of Sale is hereby incorporated herein by this
reference thereto. The Notice of Sale and Proposal for Bonds
should be reviewed by potential bidders for additional terms
and conditions of the sale of the Bonds prior to bidding on
the Bonds.
The Bonds will bear interest from their date at a single
rate of interest in a multiple of 1/8th or 1/20th of 1% per
annum specified by the successful bidder payable on each
April 1 and October 1, commencing April 1, 1997, in each
year until maturity. The purchase price specified must not
be less than $7,198,000 nor more than $7,199,000 for the
General Improvement Bonds of 1996, not less than $3,582,000
nor more than $3,583,000 for the Fiscal Year Adjustment
Bonds, and not less than $706,000 nor more than $707,000 for
the Water Capital Bonds of 1996. Bidders must at the time of
making their bids deposit a certified, cashier's or
treasurer's check in the amount of $143,960 for the General
Improvement Bonds of 1996, $71,640 for the Fiscal Year
Adjustment Bonds, and $14,120 for the Water Capital Bonds of
1996, each drawn upon a bank or trust company to the order
of the Township. The Bonds will be sold to the bidder
specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with
the terms set forth in the Notice of Sale.
Copies of the Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official
Statement relating to the Bonds may be obtained from Deborah
R. Ferrato, Chief Financial Officer, Municipal Building, 367
Valley Brook Avenue, Lyndhurst, New Jersey 07071 (telephone
Dated: September 11, 1996
(From The Bond Buyer)
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
